WITH filtered_scans AS (
  SELECT 
    s.gbsize,
    s.spanmin,
    s.scancount,
    si.healtheval
  FROM scans s
  JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
  WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
),
status_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    healtheval,
    SUM(scancount) as total_scans,
    AVG(CASE WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin <> 0 
             THEN gbsize / spanmin
             END) as avg_ratio
  FROM filtered_scans
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as mean_ratio
  FROM status_stats
  WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ss.healtheval,
  ss.total_scans,
  ss.avg_ratio,
  ss.avg_ratio - om.mean_ratio as deviation
FROM status_stats ss
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE om.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL
  AND ss.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ss.healtheval;

alternatives.interpretation: The "average file size per scan minute" could be calculated as the ratio of aggregate sums: SUM(gbsize) / SUM(spanmin) per status, rather than the average of individual per-scan ratios AVG(gbsize / spanmin). While the request's notation `(gbsize ÷ spanmin)` suggests the latter, aggregate ratios and ratio-of-aggregates yield different results.

WITH filtered_scans AS (
  SELECT 
    s.gbsize,
    s.spanmin,
    s.scancount,
    si.healtheval
  FROM scans s
  JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
  WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
),
status_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    healtheval,
    SUM(scancount) as total_scans,
    SUM(CASE WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin <> 0 
             THEN gbsize END) / 
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin <> 0 
                    THEN spanmin END), 0) as avg_ratio
  FROM filtered_scans
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as mean_ratio
  FROM status_stats
  WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ss.healtheval,
  ss.total_scans,
  ss.avg_ratio,
  ss.avg_ratio - om.mean_ratio as deviation
FROM status_stats ss
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE om.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL
  AND ss.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ss.healtheval;
